evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes lower-TRL exploratory technologies (T03 at TRL 4, T01 at TRL 5) consistent with 기술선도, and the dependency chain builds toward frontier capabilities; however, anchoring the roadmap with a high-TRL (7) near-commercial process technology as the foundation tilts the portfolio toward near-term execution rather than true technology leadership.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All four technologies are squarely within the Foundation Model / Document AI / LLM domain — document extraction, relational modeling, multimodal agents, and efficient transformer training are core competencies for this sector — showing strong domain coherence and credible competitive positioning.
